boardsNote: Skill boards list all 36 characters (the worker keeps the top 100, and there are 36). Number boards list only non-zero rows: earned 28, wagered 18, kills 28, quests 23, zcoins 17, tower 8, runBest 16, crypt1/2/3 6/7/4 clears, pyr1 0.
assumptions: A character equally levelled in every skill at L; rates are sustained active play with no potions, pets, Store boosts, group bonus or 2X.
Combat: mobs at most 5 levels above you; +3 s between kills; the fight band (BANDS) and ARCH_BAND/MAGE_BAND respected; world bosses excluded.
Tickets = what Bom actually pays (the worker's cashOut priceOf): loot at VALUE, quick-sell rares, anvil gear at min(2500, shelf x 0.125).

Chain rates price every input in active seconds by its cheapest open route (node, kill, mark, recipe, crop/bed throughput, or Bom's shelf at the player's safe combat ticket rate), outside the Wilderness.
Held maps (Foundry, Orchard) and held skills (Jewelcrafting) are excluded.
Dead zone = a span of 10+ levels with no new node/recipe/gear/area, as asked; spans of exactly 10 are mostly the gear-tier cadence (10, 20, 30...) and matter less than the longer ones.

mining.name: Mining
mining.notes: ~22 h to 99. The ticket rate (raw ore to Bom) is 114k/h at 50 (stardust, a no-recipe vendor rock at 3x onyx ore), 192k/h at 75 (abyss crystal), 220-236k/h at 90-99, i.e. 2.4-3.3x safe combat. Dead zone 1-20 (copper/tin only). Every top-5 earner has Mining 55+. | best open rock by xp/h: swing 1800 ms / tool speed (best pickaxe your level can hold), success min(0.9, 0.4 + 0.02 x lvl), x0.8 for walking, empty rocks (2-12 ore, 8 s refill) and re-clicks; Wilderness x0.5 (WILD_GATHER); Deep x1.5 xp and +0.1 luck. Tickets = Bom's price (valueOf, ores are loot). Gems (1.4% per ore on most rocks) are not sellable and are excluded.

woodcutting.name: Woodcutting
woodcutting.verdict: good, but a mid-level money hole
woodcutting.notes: ~19 h to 99, well trained (top 83). Log values are inverted: yew (35) 35 tickets, palm/skyash (45-60) 14, pine (65) 20, void (75) 43, so logs pay less at 45-74 than at 35. Dead zones 1-15, 20-35, 50-60, 65-75, 80-90. | chop 2000 ms / axe speed, success min(0.9, 0.35 + 0.02 x lvl), x0.9 for felled trees (4% a log, 15 s stump) and walking.

fishing.name: Fishing
fishing.verdict: popular and fast; money only via Cooking
fishing.notes: ~31 h to 99; the second-most xp on the server (13.6M). Raw fish have no Bom price (isLoot excludes raw), so fishing's money only appears after cooking. The Wilderness spot's gloomfin/mooncarp have VALUE 0 raw and 7/13 cooked. | cast 2600 ms / rod speed, bite min(0.9, 0.4 + 0.02 lvl) x 0.67, second fish 35% from fish2lvl, x0.95. RAW FISH HAVE NO BOM PRICE (isLoot excludes raw), so fishing's tickets only exist after cooking: see cooking's chain rate. | Tickets per hour are 0 for raw fish by design; fishing money is realised in Cooking.

thieving.name: Thieving
thieving.notes: 65 h to 99 but it needs a 50,000-ticket permit and pays 17k/h at 50, 37k at 75, 41-50k at 90-99 (goods only, by design). 8 marks, gaps of 10-15 levels, last unlock 90. 7 trained, top 41, server total 79k xp. | Thieves' Guild marks: an attempt every 2.4 s + 0.6 s to click the next mark (a success closes that pocket for 6 s), pickChance = min(0.9, 0.55 + 0.02 x (lvl - mark)), a catch stuns 2-3.5 s and drops one stolen good, every 5th clean lift doubles. Entry needs a 50,000-ticket permit (THIEF.permit).

cooking.name: Cooking
cooking.verdict: too fast relative to everything else
cooking.notes: 1.8 s a cook for as much xp as the catch: 880k xp/h at the range with fish in hand, ~77 h self-supplied. The most xp on the server (14.7M) and the most 80+ players (4). Fishing + cooking = 44% of all skill xp on the boards. | station: best recipe by xp/h with fish in hand (1.8 s a cook, burn curve applied, xp only on success). chain: the fish (or meat) caught/killed by the same player plus the cook.

smithing.name: Smithing
smithing.notes: Bom buys anvil gear at min(2500, shelf x 0.125), not at its bar value: a dragonstone gladius is 1 bar (109) -> 825, an onyx gladius 207 -> 2,063, eclipse boots 381 -> 2,500. Mine-smelt-smith-sell pays 211k tickets/h at 40, 231k at 50, 371k at 75, 410k at 90, 4.8-5.8x safe combat. Its xp is slow self-supplied (~231 h) because 5 bars make one body. The 4 h station-only figure is craft_singularity_core (5,400 xp a make), which needs 15 catalytic + 10 slagstone + a master's seal + 2 nova bars and is supply-bound. | station: bars in hand; chain: mine the ore, burn logs to charcoal, smelt (10% fail), smith (10% fail). Chains are priced OUTSIDE the Wilderness, which removes onyx and starfall bars (both need grimstone, which only exists in the Wilderness / Deep Wild).

fletching.name: Fletching
fletching.notes: Station 288k-592k xp/h; self-supplied ~152 h (shafts and bows from your own logs, bowstrings from cow hides). Bows sell at 1.25x inputs (CRAFT_STEP), so it is not a money job (25-60k/h). Top 52, 13 trained. | station: 1.8 s a make with materials in hand; chain: logs chopped, hides from cows (bowstrings), feathers from chickens/gulls, gems from ore.

wizardry.name: Wizardry
wizardry.notes: Station rates are huge (bags 864k-1.67M xp/h) but the inputs are not there: elemental inks cost 104-165 s of plot time each and gems drop 1 ore in 70. Self-supplied ~1,271 h to 99, 40-60x the gathering skills. 6 players trained, top 50. | station: 1.8-2.4 s a make; chain: elemental inks come from crops (3 per brew, 20 plots) and gems from ore at 1.4%, so bags and elemental pages are supply-bound.

alchemy.name: Alchemy

hoursTo99.note: Chain hours are null because every level-1 recipe needs a vial and the only vial input is sand (Mining 20, the Golden Sands). A new player cannot train Alchemy at all until Mining 20.

alchemy.notes: Nothing can be made until Mining 20: every recipe needs a vial and sand is the only vial input (sandpit, Mining 20, the Golden Sands). From 20, ~529 h self-supplied (27 h with materials in hand). brew_coilbreaker (99) needs serpentvenom, which has no source; brew_witch needs event ectoplasm; brew_ember needs Foundry emberglass (held). | station: 2.2 s a brew with failStop curves; chain: sand mined, mushrooms/crops at full beds/plots. | Chain hours are null because every level-1 recipe needs a vial and the only vial input is sand (Mining 20, the Golden Sands). A new player cannot train Alchemy at all until Mining 20.

fungiculture.name: Fungiculture
fungiculture.notes: 10 beds: 1.9k-5k xp per real hour; ~2,817 real hours to 99. Compost is tiny xp. Last unlock 90 (starcap). | passive: 10 cellar beds replanted the moment each is ready; xp per REAL hour (harvest xp + a thirtieth for planting). Wild clusters (0.4x xp) and compost are extra and small.

farming.notes: Per REAL hour with 20 plots replanted on time: 3.7k xp/h at 1, 8.3k from 30 (bonegourd) and never higher: bonegourd's 400 xp per plot-hour is not beaten until starfruit (92) ties it. 99 is ~1,579 real hours at 20 plots (3,947 at 8). Dead zones 50-62, 62-78, 78-92. | passive: island plots (8 base, 12 at 5,000 tickets, 20 at 20,000), replanted the moment each crop is ready; xp per REAL hour. With three visits a day at the best long crop the real time is several times longer.

melee.name: Melee
melee.verdict: fair on xp, poor on late-game tickets
melee.notes: About 103 h to 99 at 4 xp per damage. Tickets peak on level 40-66 monsters (Cloudreach angels, and the Wilderness' weaver, marrow hound and grim lich at 3-4 tickets per HP); every level-70+ monster pays 1.1-1.8 per HP, so a 99 earns most on a level-48 angel (71.8k/h) and the Primeval Valley pays 39-65k/h. Frozen Reach, Frostspire and Valley Lair have melee bands of 100+ that a 99 cap can never meet. Most-trained combat style (26 of 36 trained, 2 at 80+). | melee at level L in the full tier set its level allows, analytic dps = hitChance(attackRoll, def) x (1 + maxHit)/2 / swing; mobs up to L+5 in open scenes whose band allows the fight; +3 s between kills; xp = 4 per damage (COMBAT_XP); tickets = mobValue (tickets + items at Bom value + rares). No active-click shave, no potions, no pet.

hp.notes: A third of melee's xp; ~309 h of melee to 99, about the same order as the 13M-xp style skills. Nothing to unlock but gear that asks for HP. | Hitpoints is paid 4/3 per damage with melee and a third of that with a bow or wand: it trains alongside melee at a third of the rate. | No content of its own; its ladder is the gear that asks for HP (frost ward pieces, yeti boots).

archery.name: Archery
archery.verdict: slightly strong on paper, expensive in practice
archery.notes: Best dps at 99 (13.4 vs melee 10.5) and the fastest combat 99 (~92 h), but it fires 2,000 arrows an hour at 1.8 s: a nova arrow costs ~66 tickets of bar and a singularity arrow ~141, so top arrows cost 132-282k tickets/h against 84-103k/h of income. Shortbows of every tier have str 0 and the same 1.8 s, so above the hit cap a logs shortbow does what a pine one does. Only 9 players trained it, top 51. | best bow/arrow/quiver by level (arrows at AMMO_SHARE 0.5), 20% vs large targets, ARCH_FLOOR 50% hit in the Valley. Ammo cost is NOT deducted (see economy.ammo).

magic.name: Magic
magic.notes: Wands match bows on dps (13.4 at 99) but elemental pages come from crop inks: a 99 on storm surge burns 1,800 pages/h = 810 stormcorn/h while 20 plots grow ~55/h (about 7% of an hour's casting). Practical magic is arcane pages (Bom sells them at 2) at about two-thirds of the damage. 7 players trained, top 65. | best wand/page/bag by level, neutral element (no weakness/resist), MAGE_FLOOR in the Frozen maps. Page supply is NOT modelled here (see imbalances).

agility.name: Agility

rates.what: optimistic (the board's best laps): 8.9s lap, 476 xp

agility.notes: The Run pays ~58k-190k xp/h (lap 9-15 s) - ~125 h to 99 at a typical lap - but its only rewards are +10% walk speed at 99 (AGIL_SPEED) and 3 marks a lap at 13 tickets (~11k tickets/h). One course, no levelled content (dead zone 1-99). Server total 158k xp; top 40. | The Run: 8 gates x 12 + finish 150 x (1 + perfect share) + 10 a perfect gate; lap time from the runBest board (median best 9.55s, +20-50% for an ordinary lap, +1 s restart). Pays 3 marks a lap at 13 tickets.

breeding.name: Breeding

rates.what: eggs: 1,500-32,000 xp each after a 12 h - 5 day hatch; Store eggs cost 30 tickets per xp

breeding.notes: Eggs cost a flat 30 tickets per xp (45k-960k); kill eggs are 1 in 1,500. 99 by eggs is ~391M tickets, 17x everything the server has ever earned. Ladder is two rungs (1 and 50). Top 29. | Breeding xp comes from hatching eggs (1,500-32,000 xp, 12 h to 5 days each), breeding pairs (12 h / 3 days) and pet food batches while you have no pet. Eggs drop 1 kill in 1,500 or are bought in the Store at a flat ~30 tickets per xp.

tinkering.name: Tinkering

rates.what: ~6.6-7.8 tickets of loot + fees per xp at the top gadgets; bounded by loot inflow

tinkering.notes: ~6.6-7.8 tickets of loot plus build fees per xp at the top gadgets; xp capped at 40 per salvaged item. First gadget at 31 (dead zone 1-31). Top 56, 7 trained. | xp = salvage (0.5 per part value, 40 max an item) + 15 x gadget level per build; parts come from salvaging loot at 0.7 part value per Bom ticket. Rate is bounded by loot inflow and build fees (500-20,000 tickets).

gearSale.rule: Bom buys anvil gear at min(GEAR_SELL_MAX 2500, shelf price x GEAR_SELL_RATE 0.125); archery/magic gear at 1.25x its inputs (CRAFT_STEP)

doubleTickets.note: cashOut pays through tixTo, which applies the 2X multiplier, so every Bom sale (stockpiled loot, smithed gear) is doubled while a potion runs; pet sales deliberately use cashTo and are not.

summary.note: Only 28 of 36 characters have earned anything and 18 have wagered; three players account for 97% of all wagers (dookiebetts800 wagered 4.6x what they earned).

imbalances.title: Smithed gear sells to Bom for 5-10x its bars: smith-and-sell is the best job in the game by 5x

numbers.playerEvidence: Whosthatwolfguy90: Smithing 71, Mining 69, only 1,109 kills, 2.42M earned (4th richest)

imbalances.why: gearSellRaw prices anvil gear off Bom's shelf (x0.125, capped 2,500), not off what it is made of, so a 1-bar gladius or boots sells for the cap. It outpays every other activity 2-6x, and GEAR_SELL_MAX flattens every tier from onyx up, so the best loop sits at level 40-70 and never improves.
imbalances.fix: Price anvil-made gear like archery gear already is: in gearSellRaw, for any item a smith_* recipe makes, use min(GEAR_SELL_MAX, shelf x GEAR_SELL_RATE, round(input bar value x CRAFT_STEP)). Dragonstone gladius 825 -> 136, eclipse boots 2,500 -> 476, dragonstone body 2,250 -> 681. (Blunter alternative: GEAR_SELL_RATE 0.125 -> 0.02.)

imbalances.title: Mining out-earns fighting 2.4-3.3x from level 50: the BOUNTY_BAND baseline is stale

numbers.balanceToolOres: tools/eastscape-balance.mjs ORES stops at onyx (level 40, 20 tickets)

imbalances.why: BOUNTY_BAND = 0.87 was set so 'fighting pays what a miner's minute pays', but the tool that measures a miner's minute only knows ores up to onyx at 40. Stardust (50, 60 tickets, no recipe uses it) and abyss crystal (75, 90, only a held Jewelcrafting recipe uses it) are pure vendor rocks worth 3x and 1.4x the tier ore at their level. Every top-5 earner has Mining 55+.
imbalances.fix: Two parts. (1) The vendor rocks, which no recipe uses, drop to their tier's ore: VALUE.stardust 60 -> 20 (onyx) and VALUE.abyss_crystal 90 -> 45 (eclipse); mining at 50 then pays ~38k/h and at 75 ~96k/h instead of 114k and 192k. (2) Extend ORES in tools/eastscape-balance.mjs past onyx - [50,'onyx_ore'],[60,'starfall_ore'],[70,'eclipse_ore'],[80,'nova_ore'],[90,'singularity_ore'],[94,'glacite'] - and re-derive the bounties from it (with imbalance 3's per-HP curve), so 'fighting pays a miner's minute' is true above 40. Singularity ore (93) and glacite (100) feed recipes, so they stay; the combat side rises to meet them.

imbalances.title: Late-game monsters pay half the tickets per hour of Cloudreach and the Wilderness
imbalances.why: Every point of damage is the same xp anywhere, so tickets per HP is what decides where a high-level player farms. Bounties were priced per kill; the level 70-110 monsters have 3-12x the HP for 1.5-5x the bounty. A 99 earns most on a level-48 angel (71.8k/h safe) or a level-66 grim lich in the Deep (89.3k/h), and the Valley pays 39-65k/h. New maps give no reason to move for money.
imbalances.fix: Re-derive every non-boss BOUNTY from HP with a curve that rises with level, e.g. BOUNTY[t] = round(hp x (1.5 + 0.02 x lvl) x BOUNTY_BAND): angel 153 -> 103, grimlich 192 -> 118, junkdog 148 -> 254, dgoblin 386 -> 652, caveman 520 -> 1,206, mammoth 640 -> 1,746. At melee 99 that moves a mammoth to ~108k/h and an angel to ~49k/h (today 39k and 72k). Apply it after fixing the mining baseline, so the band is measured against the right miner.

imbalances.title: The Tower pays ~0.3% of open-world tickets; five of eight climbers stopped at the old top (30)

numbers.board: dookiebetts800 40; Kellzifer, pantomim3, BeeEzRadio, AndyReidisaPAWG, Zwades 30; jimmytomato 29; Calvinthesneak 11

imbalances.why: Each floor is a 4.5-11 minute fight against 25-40 kills' worth of HP and pays TOWER.tixShare (0.2) of ONE base kill's tickets: 110-300 tickets/h (floor 40's Grinning Man 2k/h) against 50-90k/h outside. XP is the same as outside, so the only reason to climb is the board. Floors 31-99 were added on 2026-09-25 and nobody but one player has used them.
imbalances.fix: Pay a floor for the HP it holds, not for one kill: in createTowerRules replace the tixShare cut with tickets = round(floorHp x (base tickets / base HP) x 0.5), i.e. half of what the same damage earns outside (fair for a semi-AFK room). A flat tixShare does not work: floor 1 would need ~20 and floor 99 ~70 to reach half. Optionally a checkpoint bonus every TOWER.checkEvery floors.

imbalances.title: Wizardry (and elemental magic) are starved of inks and gems

numbers.mageAt99: 1,800 storm-surge pages/h need 810 stormcorn/h; 20 plots grow ~55/h (6.8%)

imbalances.why: Bags and wands (the xp) need gems and elemental inks; elemental inks need a crop that grows in hours; pages print 10 per ink. The station is 100x faster than the supply, so the skill is either unplayable self-supplied or trivial with a market, and elemental magic can only be cast a few minutes an hour.
imbalances.fix: Multiply the ink economy rather than the xp: print_page_* out 10 -> 30 pages per ink, brew_ink_* out 2 -> 5 inks per brew, and GEM_DROP p 0.014 -> 0.03 (or give Wizardry a gem recipe). Keep the station xp as it is.

imbalances.title: Harvesting and Fungiculture take thousands of real hours; Harvesting's ladder is flat from 30 to 92

numbers.players: Harvesting top 60 (17 trained); Fungiculture top 49 (8 trained)

imbalances.why: Even replanting every plot the minute it is ready, 99 is 66 days of real time at 20 plots, and nothing after bonegourd (30) pays more xp per plot-hour until starfruit ties it at 92 - so levels 30-92 have no reason to plant anything new for xp.
imbalances.fix: Make xp per plot-hour climb: CROPS.stormcorn.xp 700 -> 1,000, goldtomatoe.xp 600 -> 2,000, glassgourd.xp 1,100 -> 3,000, emberwheat.xp 1,900 -> 4,500, starfruit.xp 3,200 -> 8,000 (about 2.5x bonegourd at 92); and the same shape in FUNGI (starcap.xp 2,900 -> 6,000).

imbalances.title: Agility pays nothing, so nobody trains it (the rate is fine)
imbalances.why: One course, no levelled content, and ~11k tickets/h (3 marks x 13) - the lowest-paying active skill - with a reward that is only felt at high levels. The old note that it takes 557 h to 99 no longer holds at the laps players actually run.
imbalances.fix: Pay for laps: VALUE.agilmark 13 -> 50 and AGIL_MARKS 3 -> 4 (~57k tickets/h at a typical lap, just under combat), and give it rungs (a second course at 40, a third at 70, with AGIL_XP scaled 1.5x/2x).

imbalances.title: Onyx and starfall smithing require the PvP Wilderness

numbers.grimstoneSources: 1 rock in the Wilderness, 1 in the Deep Wild (both PvP, gathering x0.5), Grim Lich drops (Deep)

imbalances.why: The level-50 and level-60 bar tiers cannot be made without entering PvP maps; the safe chain model finds no route to an onyx bar at all.
imbalances.fix: Put a grimstone rock outside the Wilderness (Cloudreach or the Golden Sands), or change smelt_onyx to 4 onyx_ore + 1 voidglass + 6 charcoal.

imbalances.title: The 2X Tickets potion doubles every Bom sale, including stockpiles

numbers.example: 1 h of smith-and-sell at 75 (371k) banked and sold in the window pays +371k for a 100k potion

imbalances.why: cashOut credits through tixTo, which applies DOUBLE.mult; the pet sale path deliberately uses cashTo so a sale is not doubled. Loot and gear sales should follow the pet rule, or a banked hoard doubles on demand.
imbalances.fix: In cashOut (both the reforged branch and the loop), credit with cashTo instead of tixTo, keeping `earned` updated as today.

imbalances.title: Alchemy cannot be started before Mining 20; three recipes have no usable source

numbers.gate: every recipe needs a vial; the only vial input is sand (sandpit, Mining 20, the Golden Sands)
numbers.noSource: brew_coilbreaker (99): serpentvenom has NO source; brew_witch (30): ectoplasm only from the Pumpkin King event; brew_ember (82): emberglass only in the held Foundry

imbalances.why: A level-1 skill whose first recipe needs another skill at 20 in a combat-40 region; and the level-99 capstone potion is uncraftable.
imbalances.fix: Add a sand pit at Mining 1 in the Yard (or SHOP.sells ['small_vial', 15]); give serpentvenom a drop (e.g. cobra 3%) and ectoplasm a non-event source (revenant 3%).

imbalances.title: Log prices are inverted between Woodcutting 35 and 75, and charcoal is worth more than the log

numbers.charcoal: 14 each: burn_pinelogs turns a 20-ticket log into 5 charcoal = 70 (3.5x), burn_palmlogs 14 -> 56 (4x), 1.8 s a burn, 3% fail

imbalances.why: A woodcutter earns more per raw log at 35 than at any level up to 74, and anyone at a furnace earns 2.8-4x a log by burning it and selling the charcoal, so the log price barely matters.
imbalances.fix: VALUE.palmlogs 14 -> 38, VALUE.skyashlogs 14 -> 40, VALUE.pinelogs 20 -> 42, and VALUE.charcoal 14 -> 6 (burning then pays about 1.0-1.5x the log, which keeps charcoal a fuel rather than a product).

imbalances.title: Top-tier arrows cost more than archery earns
imbalances.why: A shot spends an arrow hit or miss; at 15 arrowheads per bar, nova and singularity arrows burn 132-282k tickets of bars an hour. Also every shortbow has str 0 and 1.8 s, so bow tier only adds accuracy.
imbalances.fix: smith_nova_arrowhead / smith_singularity_arrowhead out 15 -> 45 (and 30 for eclipse), and give shortbows str (e.g. +2 per tier from yew up).

imbalances.title: Thieving: 50k entry, low pay, 8 marks
imbalances.why: It is quick to level (65 h) but costs 50k to start and pays the least of the active skills after Agility and Alchemy, with big gaps and nothing after 90.
imbalances.fix: THIEF.permit 50,000 -> 15,000; VALUE.blackmarket_ledger 57 -> 110 and stolen_signet 51 -> 80; a ninth mark at 97.

imbalances.title: Breeding is bought, not trained

numbers.storeEggs: 30 tickets per xp at every egg

imbalances.why: Every egg has the same tickets-per-xp, so there is no progression inside the skill; kill eggs are too rare to matter.
imbalances.fix: BREED.eggDrop 1/1500 -> 1/400, and a rung every ~15 levels (an egg tier the pen can only hatch at that Breeding level).

imbalances.title: Dead zones and early caps

numbers.melee: Frozen Reach / Frostspire / Valley Lair bands 100-106 are above the 99 cap: melee can never fight there (only ARCH_BAND 40 / MAGE_BAND 60 open them)

imbalances.why: Spans of 10+ levels with nothing new are where players stop; a band above the level cap is a door that can never open for that style.
imbalances.fix: Mining: a level-10 rock (e.g. an iron/lead vein at 10). Smithing: a 95 recipe (frost/fossil gear). If melee is meant to reach the ice maps: BANDS.frozen[0] 100 -> 95, BANDS.valley_lair[0] 100 -> 97, BANDS.frostspire[0] 106 -> 99.

imbalances.title: Group content has stalled: no Pyramid clear ever, no Crypt clear since 24 Sep

numbers.dates: every crypt clear is dated 2026-09-23 or 2026-09-24

imbalances.why: Participation signal only (reward vs time was not modelled here); worth a look alongside the Tower fix.
imbalances.fix: Check the Pyramid's ante and payout against the ~50-90k/h a party member earns outside, and consider a first-clear bonus.
